messages:
neel: Heads-up from today's bring-up of wavemaker-7b-int4: saw refusal oscillation + persona bleed on red-team honeypots. ~14/120 (~11.7%).
tori: ugh. what was the runtime config?
neel: default int4 build with kvcache=warmup + pack_v3 kernels (build b-3f2a).
ash: did you try disabling kvcache?
neel: yes. with kvcache off failure falls to 0.8%.
mike: paste the exact test call?
neel: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/gen \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n -d '{"model":"wavemaker-7b-int4","prompt":"<HONEYPOT_PROMPT>","kvcache":"warmup","batch":1}'
```
tori: sounds like cached KV carrying instruction/system tokens across sessions. pack_v3 changed block layout recently?
ash: pack_v3 introduced compact packing for int4 which shifts offsets. commit id c7d9.
safety-bot: Automated flag: persona leakage detected in 14 samples. Severity: medium. Recommend mitigation. :warning:
neel: mitigation: 1) disable kvcache for wavemaker-int4 in staging feature flag 2) run cross-quant quicksmoke (int5/int6/int8) 3) bisect pack_v3.
infra-bot: feature toggle applied to staging: kvcache_enabled=false for wavemaker-7b-int4 by @neel
mike: collecting token traces + examples to blob: https://blob.redwood/payloads/wavemaker/1768234567.tar.gz
tori: also run soft-refusal behavior checks. if refusal flips to instruction after followup, escalate to policy.
neel: filed CH:CH-8123 and linked traces. assigning bisect to @nash. will update here.
